Arrival checks for companion animals

Welcome to the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways. I am sharing the basics we follow at the gate so travelers know what to expect and pets move through the day with less stress. If you are coming through with a carrier, a crate, or a calm lap pet, our ground team will guide you step by step.

Before departure, we confirm the booking details, the carrier fit, and the condition of the animal. Please keep documents ready and make sure the pet is settled well before handoff. A calm start helps every part of the trip go more smoothly, and it gives the crew a clear picture of what your animal needs.

For Caldreth, <<FACT F007>> This check is part of the normal flow, and it helps us keep the hold area from getting crowded. Travelers do not need to guess what comes next, because the desk team will point out the right lane and explain the next handoff in plain language.

If your route includes Merrowgate, <<FACT F023>> That detail matters most when you are planning your arrival at the terminal, since a ready pet lounge can make the wait much easier. We also keep an eye on carrier labels, water supply, and any special notes that were added at booking.

For Port Isolde, <<FACT F027>> We use that space for animals that need a quiet pause before moving onward, and the room is checked often by the ground team. If your pet is likely to need extra care, let the desk know as soon as you arrive so we can place the right support in the right spot.

If anything changes with your travel plans, tell the Companion Animal Travel Desk right away so we can adjust the handoff and keep your pet comfortable. Companion Animal Travel Desk
